entries.title: Your first mate comes back after a used-up allowance when Claude answers again
entries.body: When your first mate pauses on a used-up allowance and checking it again shows no change, the paused card now offers to try once more. If your first mate reaches the provider another way, such as a token your own setup passes, your waiting messages go through and it stays back; if the allowance is still used up, it pauses again. A pause also ends whenever its hold ends, rather than staying on an old refusal.
entries.noPicture: This adds one button to the existing paused card, shown only after a recheck finds a used-up allowance unchanged.
